nom: Dermalogica Deep Acne Invisible Liquid Patch

segments.sensitive: Reviewers who describe their skin as sensitive mostly report no irritation or burning and say the formula is gentle enough even for a teenager's sensitive, breakout-prone skin; one sensitive-skin reviewer, however, found it very drying and recommends following up with a moisturizer.
segments.combination: The one reviewer with combination skin (23 years old) reports the treatment cut her breakouts from lasting almost two weeks down to a few days, though she found the smell strong and the tube a little hard to dispense.
segments.mature: A couple of older reviewers, including one in her 70s and one managing hormonal cystic acne at 52, report the treatment stops developing blemishes quickly despite years of persistent or recurring adult acne.

concerns.blemishes: The large majority of reviewers report visibly smaller, less inflamed blemishes within one to a few days, often overnight for cystic or under-the-skin pimples; a couple of reviewers, however, say it had no noticeable effect and one describes her acne as neither healing nor progressing while using it.
concerns.dehydration: Reports split: many reviewers, including some with sensitive or acne-prone skin, say the product does not dry out their skin, while others report it is drying — especially with repeated nightly use — and recommend following with a moisturizer or limiting use to a spot treatment.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers who mention redness report a clear, often overnight reduction around treated blemishes; one reviewer, in contrast, says it dried her acne within two days but did not reduce the redness.
concerns.spots: A couple of reviewers report the treatment also lightened dark spots or acne scarring after several days of use; this isn't mentioned by most reviewers.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer says the product absorbs a lot of oil from blemishes without being overly drying, while another, who compares it directly to acne patches, says she doesn't see it draw out oil or impurities the way patches do.
concerns.barrier: A couple of reviewers echo the product's own description of forming a semi-permeable barrier over blemishes to shield them from bacteria and pollution, though this reads more as repeating the product's claims than a personally observed effect.

aspects.libelle: Dries invisible, wears well under makeup
A little goes a long way

extraits.texte: I don't understand why this is so expensive for what it is. I was expecting some miracle product after splurging on this. I could not tell you what it does. I ended up just utilizing pimple patches again instead because I did not feel like it had any impact. I was very disappointed and will not repurchase. I recommend you save your money!

extraits.titre: Spot treatment with actual noticeable results!
extraits.texte: As the title says, this spot treatment actually gives noticeable results. I use this as my final step in my nighttime skincare routine when I notice any whiteheads creeping up. By morning, the spots have reduced in size and redness significantly, if not diseappearing completely. I'm 23 with combo skin and this makes a huge difference in how long my breakouts last, going from almost two weeks to clearing up in a few days. Took off one star because the smell is really strong and the product is a little hard to dispense, but love that this product is pregnancy safe!

I have very sensitive and acne prone skin and i have tried so many spot treatments and have gone through numerous pimple patches. This stuff makes sure deep underground pimples never reach the surface. I would say depending on the size of the pimple this product eliminates it in just a few days. Awsome product!

My aesthetician gave me a sample of this, knowing that I still, in my 70s, get serious blemishes. I was amazed at how it stopped those developing blemishes in their tracks. Gone. Like magic. So, I immediately bought this. Easy to apply. Just a little bit is needed to work the magic.

This product definitely helped to dry out my breakout and allow it to clear faster. My skin is sensitive, and this product did not cause any irritation or burning, however it is very drying ! So make sure to use a good moisturizer and don't reapply too often. It helped clear a large, painful breakout on my chin within a few days. I love this brand! Gifted by dermalogica but opinions are my own

Dermalogica gifted me. Acne liquid patch from dermalogica does a good job. It dried my acne in two days, but did not remove the redness, it leaves a white coating after application. Works well with subcutaneous acne.

My teenage son's sensitive skin was breaking out and nothing was working. This is a miracle treatment! The formula is not too harsh for sensitive and his skin looked better in a matter of a few days! I will be ordering more!
